note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible, Balanced edition, Japanese (owb-ja), verbatim, per the founder decision that Japanese quotes OWB for every work; the earlier 口語訳 (japkougo) wording is gone, and so is the book's 口語訳 credit line.
chapter_order names the chapter; block_index counts within it (the admin side-by-side blocks). A null block_index is a chapter's study-question answer, which restates the verse there.
Chapter 23's 30-day plan recites a key line per day: verbatim lines quote OWB; the paraphrased ones (days 2, 4, 18, 27, 28) stay the translator's and are self_rendered.

self_rendered otherwise: Luke 19:8 and 1 Corinthians 16:2 (ch15) are unquoted paraphrase; Mark 7:11 is an allusion; Proverbs 27:23 is the chapter's own heading phrase; Matthew 25:21 in ch21 sits inside John Wesley's sermon quotation, so it is Wesley's wording as translated, not a Bible quotation.
